refinement.detail: Searched and found none, and the two real candidates were REFUSED for recorded reasons. CANDIDATE 1: examples/validation/instruments/demonstrate.py already stages trees, judges expect_exit/expect_output and runs pytest slots, so `absent-input` looks like duplicated machinery that should import it. REFUSED for a reason already written into this repository: score_tools.py SHIPS STANDALONE (RM-05 section 3) and deliberately refuses to hard-require siblings -- `_closed_at` is duplicated from scripts/disposition.py on that exact ground, with tests/test_ledger_resolution_is_deterministic.py pinning the two to one answer. Importing a sibling under examples/ would be a new hard dependency in the one tool that has none. The duplication is also not total: the absent-input runner adds `link` and `remove`, which demonstrate.py has no equivalent of and which exist because `audit` verifies 133 sealed digests against REPO_ROOT paths, so a staging strategy that COPIES produces 133 violations that say nothing about the state under test. That was measured, not predicted. CANDIDATE 2: widen demonstrate.py's SLOTS literal to four so the existing register guards police the new block. REFUSED because tests/test_instrument_demonstrations.py is SS-06's conflict key and widening SLOTS changes what demonstrate.py EXECUTES for every one of 66 rows. Filed instead as SS-02-DF-04 with the derive-from-the-register repair named, which is the shape SM-03 already chose for the enumeration itself. No TLC run supports either decision and none is claimed: this ticket adds no TLA+ surface, ticket-local desired and current are byte-identical, and the model delta is zero against SS-03.

summary: R1 gains a third clause and it is EXECUTED: score_tools.py absent-input requires every instrument in this project's own register to ship a demonstrated ABSENT-INPUT case in THREE states (absent / unreadable / empty), answered UNDECIDED or refusal and never PASS, with collapses between states found BY EXECUTION and declared. R1 applied to the check itself: it refuses the real instrument scorecard-audit with its block removed (exit 1) and passes it with all three states staged and run (exit 0). Its own absent inputs -- absent, zero-byte, unparseable, instrument-less and empty-selection registers -- all answer UNDECIDED exit 2 with six distinct messages and never 0. Count at this tip: 2 of 56 instruments carry a contract; 54 do not, and there is no target on that ratio. NO INSTANCE OF THE CLASS WAS REPAIRED -- that is SS-05's. Suite, five numbers that sum: base 48f9c7e 8/1509/0/1/1518 -> tip PRE-CLOSE 7/1548/0/1/1556, every unit of the +38 attributed node by node (23 mine, 4 from open ticket, 11 SS-03's) and the one repaired red is SS-03's. THIS SEALED SUMMARY DESCRIBES THE PRE-CLOSE TREE; the post-close figures are in the RESULT and are the authoritative ones. Four findings filed, SS-02-DF-01..04, ledger 317 -> 321 rows, appended only.

ticket.objective: THE CONSUMPTION THIS PROGRAMME OWES, AND THE REASON THE EPIC EXISTS. R1 REQUIRES A DEMONSTRATED FAILING INPUT ON A REAL SUBJECT. IT DOES NOT REQUIRE A DEMONSTRATED ABSENT ONE. THAT SINGLE GAP IS WHY ALL 48 INSTANCES SHIPPED -- each satisfied R1 IN FULL and still answered PASS to the question it was built to refuse. YOUR SLICE IS THE RULE AND THE INSTRUMENT, NOT THE REPAIRS -- SS-05 does the repairs, and if you start fixing instances you will both blow your slice and shrink the class SS-08 has to measure. EXTEND R1: every instrument ships a demonstrated ABSENT-INPUT case, and THE CORRECT ANSWER TO AN ABSENT INPUT IS UNDECIDED OR A REFUSAL, NEVER PASS. THE WORKED SHAPE IS A SIGNATURE CHANGE: score_tools._finding_ids went set[str] -> set[str] | None, because THE OLD TYPE COULD NOT DISTINGUISH 'READ AND FOUND NOTHING' FROM 'READ NOTHING' AND ANSWERED THE SECOND WITH THE FIRST. That is the class in one line, and the third state was demonstrated too -- against a tree with no ledger live or archived, audit_rh3 emits ONE UNVERIFIED LINE instead of 14 fabrication claims, and UNVERIFIED does not increment the violation count. NOW LAND IT AS AN EXECUTED CHECK. A DOCTRINE LINE WITH NO INSTRUMENT IS A PREFERENCE, and the predecessor measured 1-of-41 consumption and then filed 57 findings while consuming almost none. THE CHECK RUNS OVER THIS PROJECT'S OWN INSTRUMENT REGISTER, and it is IN THE PERMITTED POPULATION under the adjudicated static-gates doctrine: static checks over this project's own record, metadata and method have 3 catches : 1 false refusal, and the doctrine MAY NOT refuse them. IT IS NOT A GATE ON AN ADOPTER'S CODE AND MUST NOT BECOME ONE. R1 APPLIES TO YOUR OWN CHECK: demonstrate it REFUSING A REAL INSTRUMENT IN THIS REPOSITORY -- failing before, passing after -- not a fixture. AND THE OBVIOUS SELF-REFERENTIAL TRAP, WHICH YOU MUST NOT FALL INTO: YOUR CHECK IS ITSELF AN INSTRUMENT THAT CAN BE HANDED AN ABSENT INPUT. An empty register, an absent register, a register that parses to nothing -- what does your check answer? If it answers PASS you have shipped the 49th instance INSIDE the fix for the class. DEMONSTRATE THE ANSWER. THE SUB-SHAPES ARE ENUMERATED FOR YOU in CA-10-absent-input/RESULT.md section 3.2 and the next sweep is cheaper because of it: absent-path-returns-empty; vacuous all()/not any(); one-sided threshold trivially satisfied by zero; .get() collapsing both sides of a comparison; unparseable becoming indistinguishable from absent; default-named lookup missing silently; empty selection reported as a satisfied population.
